It is possible to make overloads at level 90 Herblore with the aid of a spicy stew (with brown spice) getting a +6 level boost; it is also possible to create them at level 89 Herblore, using the artisan skills boost from an advanced pulse core. However, the most reliable and longest-lasting boost is a God banner, which provides a +2 bonus for 30 minutes. Using a preset inventory with appropriate quantities of each of the 7 ingredients greatly reduces the time spent banking.
With 120 Herblore, overloads can be made in a batch, creating five potions with the ingredients of four potions. This is only available when the Herblore master cape perk is active (worn, present in max cape, or on the skillcape rack). Making a batch of overloads can trigger the perks of the scroll of cleansing, modified botanist's mask, but cannot trigger the effects of a botanist's amulet.
The ingredients of an overload can be combined into a stackable unfinished potion by Granny Rowan once the tier 3 Botanist's Workbench has been constructed in Fort Forinthry. Unfinished overloads can then be finished at the workbench for the usual experience. The usual potion duplication bonuses apply, but ingredient-saving bonuses do not; the master cape also unlocks a batch recipe for unfinished potions.
▸ Production costs
